requirement: Check eligibility asks aMember once per unsuppressed recipient, page by page, stores allow/none/unknown with no address, and the screen loops pages and shows the totals

oracle.invariant: Without AMEMBER_API_KEY the check answers REAL_MEMBER_CHECK_OFF and makes no request. Pages of 3 then 1 cover the 4 unsuppressed recipients; the suppressed one is never asked; nextCursor ends null. Answers are stored as allow 1, none 2 (expired plan and no account), unknown 1 with reason HTTP_502; no stored row contains an address; a second pass replaces rows instead of adding. The Overview card sends cursors null, c1, c2 with limit 50 and then shows 100 with an active plan, 15 without, 5 not answered, of 120 checked.
